headline: Understanding PagedAttention & Memory Fragmentation in KV Cache
summary: PagedAttention partition's KV cache into fixed-size blocks (pages) stored in non-contiguous physical memory, eliminating virtual memory fragmentation and enabling 96%+ KV memory utilization for high-throughput batching.
why_it_matters: Eliminating memory fragmentation allows doubling active batch sizes on standard 80GB A100/H100 GPUs.

headline: Speculative Decoding Deep Dive: Draft Models & Verification
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by using a small draft model to generate multiple candidate tokens in parallel, verified in a single forward pass by the target LLM.
why_it_matters: Achieves 2-3x latency reduction for single-user latency-sensitive inference without changing output distribution.

headline: Disaggregated Prefill and Decode Architecture Explained
summary: Decouples computation-heavy prefill nodes (TTFT optimized) from memory-heavy decode nodes (TPOT/throughput optimized), eliminating resource contention in multi-tenant inference clusters.
why_it_matters: Reduces inter-token latency spike by 40% when high-prompt-length requests arrive during heavy decode streams.

headline: RadixAttention: Automatic Prefix Caching in SGLang
summary: SGLang maintains a Radix tree over prompt tokens across multiple requests to reuse KV cache tensors for identical prompt prefixes automatically.
why_it_matters: Critical for multi-turn chat applications and system prompts, boosting throughput up to 5x.

headline: FP8 Quantization: E4M3 vs E5M2 for Inference Workloads
summary: Comparing FP8 representation formats for deep learning inference: E4M3 preserves dynamic range for weights, while E5M2 handles dynamic activation spikes.
why_it_matters: Doubles Tensor Core compute throughput on NVIDIA Hopper architectures while keeping perplexity loss under 0.1%.

headline: Continuous Batching (Iteration-level Batching) Mechanics
summary: Instead of waiting for an entire batch to finish generation, continuous batching inserts new requests into the batch as soon as old requests reach EOS tokens.
why_it_matters: Increases GPU hardware utilization from ~20% to ~85% under real-world Poisson arrival workloads.

headline: vLLM v0.6.2 Released with Multi-Step Execution & Chunked Prefill
summary: vLLM v0.6.2 introduces multi-step scheduling to reduce Python overhead, along with enhanced chunked prefill integration for hybrid workload processing.
why_it_matters: Reduces CPU overhead by 30% for small-batch low-latency serving workloads on modern clusters.

headline: FlashInfer v0.1.6 Support for FP8 & Grouped Query Attention
summary: FlashInfer library announces updated CUDA kernels for GQA with FP8 precision, enabling sub-millisecond decode kernels for Llama 3 70B.
why_it_matters: Direct plug-in kernel enhancement for SGLang and vLLM backend performance.

headline: TensorRT-LLM 0.12 Release: Native Medusa & EAGLE Integration
summary: NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM 0.12 adds built-in C++ execution pipelines for Medusa and EAGLE speculative decoding heads.
why_it_matters: Simplifies deployment of speculative heads in production enterprise microservices with Tensor Core acceleration.

headline: llm-d: Open-Source Disaggregated Inference Daemon Launched
summary: A lightweight distributed daemon for routing prefill and decode phases across heterogeneous GPU nodes with dynamic load balancing.
why_it_matters: Brings enterprise-grade disaggregated serving to self-hosted Kubernetes clusters.

headline: GuideLLM & GenAI-Perf: Standardized Benchmarking Suite Release
summary: Neural Magic releases GuideLLM alongside MLPerf updates for automated throughput vs latency trade-off sweeps for open-weights models.
why_it_matters: Provides standard metrics (TTFT, TPOT, ITL) to select optimal concurrency settings.

headline: Qwen2.5-Coder 7B Serving Benchmark on Single T4 GPU
summary: Benchmarking Qwen2.5-Coder 7B using vLLM + AWQ 4-bit quantization on free Google Colab T4 GPUs, reaching 45 tokens/sec.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates high-performance developer assistance models running on free commodity cloud hardware.

headline: Why TTFT and TPOT Matter More Than Raw Tokens Per Second
summary: Traditional average tokens/sec obscures user experience. Time-to-First-Token (TTFT) dictates perceived responsiveness while Time-per-Output-Token (TPOT) measures reading flow.
why_it_matters: High tokens/sec with high TTFT creates a laggy user experience; optimizing for tail latencies is the key differentiator.

headline: Contrarian Take: Why 4-Bit Quantization Isn't Always Free Lunch
summary: While AWQ and GPTQ reduce VRAM, decompression overhead on non-tensor-core ops can actually slow down decode phase for small batch sizes.
why_it_matters: Great post angle showing when unquantized FP16 or FP8 outperforms 4-bit quantization under batch-size-1 workloads.

headline: The Hidden Costs of Disaggregated Prefill & Decode Networks
summary: Inter-node KV cache transfer over PCIe or Ethernet can quickly become the bottleneck in disaggregated serving clusters if interconnect bandwidth is undersized.
why_it_matters: Exposes infrastructure realities beyond basic academic benchmarks for systems architects.

headline: Small Language Models (SLMs) Are Outperforming 70B LLMs in Dedicated Tools
summary: Fine-tuned 3B/7B models (Phi-3.5, SmolLM, Qwen2.5) paired with structured outputs (Outlines, xGrammar) beat 70B models on constrained JSON generation.
why_it_matters: High-engagement LinkedIn narrative on cost-efficiency and localized edge inference.

headline: Why Custom CUDA Kernels Are No Longer the Only Edge in LLM Serving
summary: Framework-level batch scheduling, prefix caching, and memory management yield far greater speedups than micro-optimizing individual GEMM kernels.
why_it_matters: Shifts focus from hardware-level optimization to system architecture and scheduling algorithms.

headline: Unsloth + bitsandbytes: Fine-tuning & Inferencing on Consumer GPUs
summary: How memory-efficient gradient checkpointing and 4-bit base model loading allow 15B models to be trained and evaluated on 16GB VRAM GPUs.
why_it_matters: Inspiring post topic empowering individual developers and researchers without million-dollar GPU clusters.
